title: Telegraph Cucumber - 2x Mini Plug Plants - Heavy Cropper
description:
Grow Your Own Crisp & Delicious Cucumbers at Home!


KEY FEATURES
• Produces long, smooth, virtually seedless cucumbers
• Excellent crisp texture and refreshing flavour
• High-yielding and vigorous growth
• Perfect for salads, sandwiches, and snacking
• Easy to grow in greenhouses or sheltered outdoor spots


PLANT DETAILS
Type: Vegetables — Cucumis sativus 'Telegraph'
Colour: Green (fruit)
Season: Summer to Autumn (fruiting)
Growth Habit: Climbing/Vining
Flavour: Mild, sweet, and crisp with a refreshing, slightly watery texture
Time to Harvest: 10-12 weeks from planting


GROWING CONDITIONS
Sun: Full sun
Soil: Well-drained, fertile soil, rich in organic matter
Watering: Keep consistently moist, especially during fruiting. Avoid overwatering.
Spacing: 60-90 cm (24-36 inches) between plants
Height: Up to 2-3 metres (6-10 feet) if trellised
Spread: 60-90 cm (24-36 inches)
Hardiness: UK H1b (protect from frost)


CARE INSTRUCTIONS
• Transplant into larger pots or directly into prepared soil once all risk of frost has passed.
• Provide a strong support system (trellis, netting, or stakes) for the climbing vines.
• Feed regularly with a high-potash fertiliser once flowers appear to encourage fruiting.
• Water at the base of the plant to avoid wetting the foliage, which can lead to fungal diseases.
• Harvest regularly when fruits are young and tender to encourage further production.


WHAT'S INCLUDED
2x Mini Plug Plants


DISPATCH
Plants are carefully packed and dispatched Monday-Wednesday to avoid weekend delays.
